label.purpose: 面板标题、状态徽标、仪表标题；12px 以下专用。

mono.purpose: 终端、命令、代码、主机地址、指标数值。

shadows.name: abyss
shadows.purpose: 模态与浮层的深空投影（带偏移的结构阴影）。

shadows.name: glow-overload
shadows.purpose: 高危警示辉光——视觉音量最高。

motion.name: ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: 强调性减速（模态、开关旋钮）。

motion.name: spring-indicator
motion.purpose: motion 库 layoutId 指示器滑动。

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: 通电元件：能量渐变底 + 深色文字，hover 渐变位移增亮。
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 26px; padding: 0 12px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; background: linear-gradient(100deg, #7c5cff, #00e5ff); background-size: 150% 100%; background-position: 100% 50%; color: #041018; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-position 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), box-shadow 120ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-position: 0% 50%; box-shadow: 0 2px 14px rgba(0,229,255,0.32), 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Compact Button
components.description: 22px 紧凑主 CTA：面板头等窄位的唯一常驻动作入口。
components.css: .ds-btn-compact { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 22px; padding: 0 8px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; background: linear-gradient(100deg, #7c5cff, #00e5ff); background-size: 150% 100%; background-position: 100% 50%; color: #041018; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-position 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), box-shadow 120ms; } .ds-btn-compact:hover { background-position: 0% 50%; box-shadow: 0 2px 14px rgba(0,229,255,0.32); } .ds-btn-compact:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: 静默元件：半透明冷蓝底，无辉光。
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 26px; padding: 0 12px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(140,160,255,0.08); color: #c6cbe0; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(140,160,255,0.14); }

components.name: Input
components.description: focus = 通电：volt 描边 + 电场外圈。
components.css: .ds-input { width: 240px; padding: 6px 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(140,160,255,0.22); border-radius: 4px; background: #10131f; color: #f0f3ff; font-size: 13px; outline: none; transition: border-color 120ms, box-shadow 120ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8a93b2; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #00e5ff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,229,255,0.16), 0 0 12px rgba(0,229,255,0.32); }

components.name: Circuit Node Card
components.description: 电路节点卡：激活时能量流描边 + 呼吸辉光。
components.css: .ds-card-active { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 260px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(#0d1020, #0d1020) padding-box, linear-gradient(100deg, #00e5ff, #ff2d95 30%, #7c5cff 60%, #00e5ff) border-box; background-size: 100% 100%, 300% 100%; animation: ds-flow 3.2s linear infinite; } @keyframes ds-flow { from { background-position: 0% 50%, 0% 50%; } to { background-position: 0% 50%, -300% 50%; } } .ds-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #3dffa8; box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(61,255,168,0.35); } .ds-card-name { font-size: 13px; color: #c6cbe0; } .ds-card-sub { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', Consolas, monospace; font-size: 10.5px; color: #8a93b2; } .ds-badge-live { margin-left: auto; font-family: 'Chakra Petch', sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(61,255,168,0.5); color: #3dffa8; box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(61,255,168,0.15); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: 丝印状态徽标：Chakra Petch + 状态色描边。
components.css: .ds-badge-surge { font-family: 'Chakra Petch', sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,176,32,0.5); color: #ffb020; background: transparent; }

components.name: Switch Chip
components.description: 带状态灯的通电开关芯片：灯亮 = 开启，用于一切持续生效的开关。
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 24px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(140,160,255,0.22); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #8a93b2; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 120ms, border-color 120ms, box-shadow 120ms; } .ds-chip-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #6a7394; transition: background 120ms, box-shadow 120ms; } .ds-chip-on { color: #00e5ff; border-color: rgba(0,229,255,0.5); background: rgba(0,229,255,0.06); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(0,229,255,0.12); } .ds-chip-on .ds-chip-dot { background: #00e5ff; box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(0,229,255,0.32); }

components.name: High-Voltage Confirm Bar
components.description: 高危命令确认门：overload 嗡鸣 + 深色文字合闸钮（信任红线的视觉形态）。
components.html: ⚠️ 写操作需要你的确认
components.css: .ds-hv { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; width: 320px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,77,109,0.65); border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(255,77,109,0.08); animation: ds-hum 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-hum { 0%,100% { box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255,77,109,0.25); } 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255,77,109,0.4); } } .ds-hv-reason { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #ff4d6d; } .ds-hv-allow { padding: 4px 12px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; background: #ff4d6d; color: #2a040c; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-hv-allow:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(255,77,109,0.4); }

narrative.northStar: 通电的电路板（The Live Circuit）
narrative.overview: 整个工作台是一块通电的暗色电路板：服务器是电路节点，AI 是副驾电源，命令与数据是在电路中流动的能量。通电（活跃）、流动（执行/传输/思考）、高压（危险）三种能量形态就是界面的语言。Operate 模式：表达永不遮蔽任务，终端视口内零特效。
keyCharacteristics: 深空底 + 发光 hairline 描边，面板即电路板
能量渐变只表达「进行中/活跃」，静止元素不上渐变
弹簧位移 + 发光呼吸双动效族
中文正文系统栈，标签用 Chakra Petch 丝印体，等宽 JetBrains Mono

rules.name: The Energy-Means-Motion Rule
rules.body: plasma→circuit→volt 渐变只出现在「正在发生」的元素上；静止元素永远不披渐变。

rules.name: The High-Voltage Rule
rules.body: overload 红的视觉音量必须压过一切装饰；装饰动画永远不得使用 overload 红。

rules.name: The Silk-Screen Rule
rules.body: Chakra Petch 只出现在 12px 以下的标签面。

rules.name: The Glow-Is-State Rule
rules.body: 辉光是状态不是装饰：volt=活跃、circuit=思考、live=在线、surge=警示、overload=危险。

rules.name: The One-Switch Rule
rules.body: 每个动作全应用只保留一个常驻入口：新建连接 = 连接面板头部 CTA；后端设置 = ActivityBar 底部；LLM 设置 = 对话面板。空态引导与启动门自救按钮是上下文通道，不算重复。

dos: Do 把 keyframes 定义在消费它的 CSS Module 文件内
Do 动画只碰 transform/opacity/background-position，进度用 scaleX
Do 为无限循环动画补 prefers-reduced-motion 关停
Do 新增颜色同步 index.css 与 themeStore.ThemePalette 双侧
Do 有色底文字用同族深色 ink 保 4.5:1
donts: Don't 给静止元素上能量渐变或辉光
Don't 恢复浅色主题路径（本世界仅深色）
Don't 在 xterm 视口内叠加特效
Don't 同屏超过 3 处常驻流动动画
Don't 用 PowerShell 管道改写含中文的源文件
